# 🤝 Contributing to Electrolite

Please feel free to contribute to this project! 

We welcome all kinds of contributions, whether it is fixing bugs, optimizing performance, or improving documentation.

### 📢 Specific Call for Device Testing
If you own any ASUS laptop model different from the **ASUS Zephyrus G16 (2025)**, your help is especially appreciated! Please let us know if:
* The app works successfully on your model.
* You can offer extra features or support tailored to other ASUS models.

Thank you for helping make Electrolite better!
